# Step - median

`median` · category: [Aggregation](../../traversal/step_reference.md#aggregation)

Yields the median of the numbers in the stream.

## Forms

```text
median()
```

## Example

```rhai,graph=modern
g.v().values("age").median().next()   // 30.5
```
